options.content: Now that you're cursed, you'll answer questions to earn snowballs. Use your snowball launcher to knockout players and spread the curse!
You were chosen as the first one to get cursed. Now you answer questions to earn snowballs. Use your snowball launcher to knockout players and spread the curse!

After realizing that our own agents can be cursed, I started to wonder what other potential dangers we may face. Recently, while in the farming area, I noticed some peculiar occurrences that I can't quite explain. The longer I stayed in that area, the more unusual I felt, as though I was being affected in a strange and corrupt way. Upon discussing this with others, I discovered that they did not experience similar effects. However, as a precautionary measure, I suggest that all agents avoid the farming area
You need bait in order to fish. Go earn bait by answering questions at the Question Answering Station!
Looking for fish...
A gray(t) catch.
Just blending in...
Believe it or not, I'm all natural.
Just because I'm green, doesn't mean I'm healthy.
Probably not much you can do with this.

Vesper, if you're reading this, it means the experiment worked. You know how sometimes you vaguely remember past experiences but then it feels like you're starting fresh when you wake up? Well, I'm writing this note in the past and if you're reading it now, that means communication between our existences somehow survived. This note has survived unique existences. Vesper, please try to send a signal back. If I hear from you, it would change everything.

options.grantedItemDescription: Gather 10 Gold Keys to unlock the vault.

options.content: You're representing Gimkit...so look sharp.
The experiment works. There is a way to communicate between existences!
How were you able to communicate with me? I've been struggling--
Wait, wait. You're not Vesper.
Oh my goodness, Vesper. You did it!
No, no, you're something much worse. You're the one that has been...
Nevermind. Look, I don't trust you.
Maybe interexistence communication is opening a can of worms I'm not ready for.
For my own safety, I must go. I hope you never find me.

When we arrived, I was confused about what was happening because this place is so different from any place I've been before. There is snow, sand, and dirt all in the same area, which doesn't seem to make sense. While trying to figure out what's going on, I keep seeing the term "Project Map" appear, but I don't know what it means. I wonder if there is a map that could help me find answers.
